title: Delta
$comment: Role: the canonical streaming delta union (docs/architecture.md §3.1; ocai/chat/types/stream.py). One document = one Delta in omit-absent wire form, mirroring the part taxonomy one-to-one (the streaming ratchet: no new part type without its delta type). The `type` tag is an OPEN string vocabulary: known canonical tags dispatch to a variant subschema via if/then; a tag this revision does not know matches no branch and still validates (that payload decodes to DeltaUnknown — total decode, never a raise). The M2 chat_chunk.schema.json references this file for its `delta` lane.
description: One canonical streaming delta: a tagged union on `type`, kept open through the delta registry. Applied to an open part slot by StreamAccumulator with append semantics per delta type.

type.description: The open delta discriminator. Known canonical tags: text, tool_args, reasoning, signature, annotation, refusal, blob (plus the placeholder `undefined`). Unknown tags are LEGAL: readers decode them to DeltaUnknown, preserving the payload verbatim.

deltaText.description: A text fragment appended to the open text part (DeltaText).

deltaToolArgs.description: A tool-argument string fragment appended to the open tool_call part (DeltaToolArgs). Raw string pieces concatenated onto args_json and parsed once, at PART_STOP — fragments are rarely valid JSON on their own.

fragment.description: The raw argument-string fragment, appended verbatim.

deltaReasoning.description: A reasoning fragment appended to the open reasoning part (DeltaReasoning); the two textual lanes stream independently on some interfaces.

text.description: A raw reasoning-text fragment, when streamed.

deltaSignature.description: A reasoning-signature fragment for the open reasoning part (DeltaSignature); signatures stream as opaque string pieces and the codec's transducer mints the final ProviderRef on the sealed part.

deltaAnnotation.description: A completed citation appended to the open text part (DeltaAnnotation); annotations arrive whole, never as fragments.

deltaRefusal.description: A refusal-text fragment appended to the open refusal part (DeltaRefusal).

deltaBlob.description: A base64 media fragment appended to the open media part (DeltaBlob); the sealed part's inline base64 Source is the concatenation.
